quote: You pretend to be fine when everything inside is quietly falling apart. You swallow your heavy tears in the dark room alone. Nobody notices the silent weight you carry every single day. You keep hiding your tired soul behind a gentle smile. Eventually, the mask becomes heavier than the pain it hides.
